_note: The compiler tests string literals and template chunks for bidirectional control characters with one global regex whose lastIndex survives from one compiled component to the next, and svelte-check compiles every component in one process. Components reach the compiler after the fallback preprocessor's awaits: B (no <script> or comment) first, then C (a comment only), then A and D (scripts) in discovery order. So C's first literal is searched from where B left the regex and misses, and A and D start past the bidi character in their first literal and report the template chunk instead. Verified against upstream svelte-check.
